title: 67-year-old ex-communist militia member surrenders in Oriental Mindoro

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A 67-year-old former militia member associated with a communist rebel group surrendered to authorities in Victoria, Oriental Mindoro, on Friday, Oct. 16, police said. The man, a married government employee and farmer, previously served in the Milisyang Bayan of the Communist Terrorist Group’s (CTG) KLG Ignacio Calabria Magadia unit, which operates in the province, according to the Oriental Mindoro Police Provincial Office (OrMin PPO). He surrendered at the headquarters of the 1st Provincial Mobile Force Company in Barangay San Isidro, Victoria, to Lt. Col. Aldwin Santos, company commander, and Capt. Joselito A.
